title: Step determined by configuration code
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, and let $C,n,s$ be natural numbers such that $C$ is at least the number of states plus $6$ times the number of work tapes plus $5$. Let $x$ be a Boolean string of length $n$, and let $c,d$ be configurations on $x$ whose work-tape head positions lie within distance $s$ of the origin and whose tape contents are blank outside that window. If $c$ and $d$ have the same configuration code, then after one step of $M$ their states, input-head positions, work-tape contents, work-tape head positions, and output summaries agree.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is at least the number of states plus $6$ times the number of work tapes plus $5$
both configurations have all work-tape head positions within distance $s$ of the origin
both configurations have blank work-tape cells outside that window
the configuration codes of $c$ and $d$ agree
